items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: Now I asked -- later I worked with them a lot and became friendly with them and I think Harry's the one I asked about it.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. You know, actually I have a recollection of the Mills Brothers coming through when they were down on their luck and they stopped in our high school and said, you know, $50.00 to get us to San Francisco, we'll give a concert to the kids. This was in 1932.

Now I asked -- later I worked with them a lot and became friendly with them and I think Harry's the one I asked about it. Of course, he wouldn't remember it. He said he doesn't remember Tracy, particularly, but he said, we did that plenty of times.
